commentary: While benchmark indices surged on heavy buying in select mega-cap IT and Reliance, market breadth remains fragile at 40 with a deterministic WEAK gate. Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil repeatedly cautioned against confusing large-cap index window-dressing with true underlying market health. Significant mid-and-small-cap divergence points to distribution under the hood. In this environment, Livermore's discipline dictates patience and progressive exposure: avoid chasing extended beta and allocate capital strictly to verified Stage 2 leaders showing explosive CANSLIM earnings acceleration and institutional volume pivots. Until breadth confirms broad accumulation, risk mitigation and rigorous stop discipline must take absolute precedence over aggressive positioning.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

63MOONS.technical: Consolidating tightly within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot above the 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA on 1.75x volume. RSI at 61 shows steady momentum, but relative strength remains choppy due to volatile historical price swings.
63MOONS.fundamental: Despite strong top-line sales of ₹137 crore (+350% YoY), operating and net profitability remain deeply negative (-₹99 crore TTM profit). Negative ROE (-4.9%) and lack of institutional sponsorship disqualify the stock under CANSLIM.
63MOONS.risk: A breakdown below the scanner stop at ₹874.22 breaches moving average support, signaling immediate thesis failure and mandatory capital defense.

ABDL.technical: Forming a constructive near-breakout handle within 1.5% of the 20-session pivot. Price is positioned well above its 21 EMA and 50 SMA with RSI at 69 and MACD positive above the zero line.
ABDL.fundamental: Operating profit margin improved to 13.85%, and Q1 net profit reached ₹68 crore (+11.9% YoY). However, muted single-digit top-line growth (+5.3%) fails CANSLIM's 15% sales and 25% EPS acceleration benchmarks.
ABDL.risk: Violation of the ₹687.01 pivot stop signals lack of buying demand; exit immediately to prevent capital erosion.

ADVANCE.technical: High-powered 20-day high breakout into new 52-week territory backed by massive 7.66x volume expansion. Price rides cleanly above rising 21 EMA and 50 SMA with market-leading relative strength.
ADVANCE.fundamental: Textbook CANSLIM C+A profile: Q1 net profit surged 152% YoY to ₹22.55 crore on explosive 96% sales growth to ₹330 crore. Robust ROCE of 19.6% and clean balance sheet reflect genuine institutional demand.
ADVANCE.risk: A close back below the breakout trigger stop at ₹134.56 confirms a failed breakout, requiring immediate execution of stop-loss rules.

AEGISLOG.technical: Completing a classic double bottom pattern, rebounding decisively above the 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA on 4.64x average volume. MACD is positive above signal with firm momentum.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Standout growth: Q1 consolidated net profit jumped 211% YoY to ₹545 crore on 37% revenue expansion. Operating margins expanded to 34.8% and annual ROE holds near 15%, backed by strong institutional sponsorship.
AEGISLOG.risk: A breach of the ₹1379.53 double bottom support level breaks technical market structure and triggers a rapid stop-loss exit.

AEROENTER.technical: Sculpting a textbook double bottom reversal above rising 21 EMA and 50 SMA. Price is pushing toward neckline resistance on 1.48x volume with RSI at 59 and an active MACD bullish cross.
AEROENTER.fundamental: Spectacular earnings acceleration: Q1 net profit rocketed 616% YoY to ₹103.2 crore on 135% revenue growth to ₹333 crore. The company is virtually debt-free with solid 52% promoter ownership.
AEROENTER.risk: A drop below the base support stop at ₹145.36 invalidates the double bottom reversal, demanding swift capital preservation.

ANUHPHR.technical: Testing double bottom neckline resistance above rising 50, 150, and 200 DMAs on an impressive 3.28x volume surge. However, relative strength has lagged the broader sector over the medium term.
ANUHPHR.fundamental: Q1 net profit rose 37.6% YoY to ₹11.4 crore, but top-line revenue stalled at +3.9% (₹193.8 crore). Despite zero debt and 14.9% ROCE, subdued sales momentum restricts leadership status.
ANUHPHR.risk: A breakdown below the swing pivot stop at ₹91.54 invalidates the bottoming base and commands an immediate defensive cut.
